scope: Located Concurso 36/2012 court-file material from the earlier of 2016 or convenio: 1 January 2016 through 31 December 2021, with connected external material separately typed.

status_definitions.primary_text: Official judicial/LAJ act extracted to searchable text and operative effect checked.
status_definitions.party_text: Party or insolvency-administration filing extracted to searchable text; position only, not a finding.
status_definitions.ocr_redacted: Scan rendered, OCRed, visually checked and converted to a redacted public derivative.
status_definitions.scan_pending: Binary located; reliable page-faithful public text still requires OCR and review.

governing_rules: recognized credit != mortgage ceiling != better-offer threshold != deed consideration != registry value != surplus
LPB estate != the whole mixed-ownership Sun Park complex
connected criminal complaint != Mercantile Court filing != criminal finding

records.title: AC filing of definitive report texts
records.effect: Asked the court to treat the definitive report texts as timely filed; annex completeness and disposition remain separate.

records.title: LPB opposition concerning the definitive creditor list
records.effect: Records LPB's objections; does not by itself prove that any objection was accepted.

records.title: Order modifying definitive texts for Community credit
records.effect: Included a contingent ordinary pre-insolvency Community credit without its own amount; did not finally validate later quantified or post-insolvency claims.

records.title: Order ending common phase and opening convenio
records.effect: Ended the common phase and called a creditors' meeting for 28 June 2017.

records.title: LPB viability and payment plan
records.effect: Advanced LPB's viability assumptions and asset description; not a court-adopted valuation or feasibility finding.

records.title: Filing presenting proposal, viability plan and payment plan
records.effect: Records submission of the proposal package; receipt does not establish approval or creditor adhesion.

records.title: LPB convenio proposal
records.effect: Proposed no haircut and full payment of ordinary claims after one year, later payment of subordinated claims and an Aweswell guarantee; privileged creditors remained outside absent adhesion.

records.title: Order fixing definitive AC remuneration for common phase
records.effect: Located official copy; remuneration inputs, service and payment implementation remain separate.

records.title: Promontoria Holding 122 reconsideration filing
records.effect: Records the specially privileged creditor's challenge; outcome must be read from the later act chain.

records.title: AC filing concerning assignment of Promontoria credits to CAM
records.effect: Requested modification of the definitive texts to record the asserted credit assignment.

records.title: Order opening liquidation
records.effect: Opened LPB liquidation, suspended LPB's powers over its own patrimony, dissolved LPB and required a plan and quarterly reports.

records.title: Order recognizing CAM as transferee of specified Promontoria credits
records.effect: The current three-page primary-source control dates the order to 15 February 2018 and recognizes two specified specially privileged principals plus unquantified contingent costs; it does not set later accrued interest.
records.supersession_control: SUPERSEDED date layers 8/9/14 February are not published as facts and require direct reinspection/authentication of a distinct act before reuse.

records.title: AC proposed liquidation plan
records.effect: Proposed realization rules and payment under the Insolvency Act; judicial approval and modifications are separate.

records.title: AC request to clarify interest treatment
records.effect: Advanced the AC's requested clarification; the 16-Apr interest order controls the result.

records.title: LPB observations on liquidation plan
records.effect: Requested modifications to the AC plan; not all requested modifications were adopted.

records.title: LPB supplemental observations on clarification
records.effect: Supplemented LPB's plan/interest position; outcome is controlled by the later orders.

records.title: Order clarifying specially privileged interest
records.effect: Allowed interest to increase only up to the limits agreed in the respective mortgages.

records.title: Order approving liquidation plan with qualifications
records.effect: Approved dation of listed mortgaged apartments and a separate EUR 400,000 sale of listed premises/pools, subject to publicity and better-offer controls; did not adopt Actúa values as findings.

records.title: CAM filing quantifying debt with loan deeds/calculation
records.effect: Records CAM's calculation and annexed instruments; figures remain source statements pending judicial and accounting reconciliation.

records.title: LPB opposition to CAM interest quantification
records.effect: Argued mortgage/value ceilings and subordinate treatment for excess interest; the AP order later partly accepted only the ceiling branch.

records.title: Order clarifying better-offer licitation method
records.effect: Explained that any later licitation would be a judicial appearance allowing successive bids until a final offer.

records.title: LAJ Diligencia ordering publicity and a ten-day improvement period
records.effect: Ordered notice in the office and Public Insolvency Register and a licitation if a better offer appeared; performance returns remain open.

records.title: LPB appeal against plan/interest treatment
records.effect: Advanced LPB's appeal grounds; the 23-Jul-2019 AP order partly allowed only the interest-ceiling branch.

records.title: Order partially suspending realization pending appeal
records.effect: Suspended realization of the listed mortgaged apartments while allowing liquidation of other estate assets to continue.

records.title: LPB reconsideration against LAJ procedure
records.effect: Challenged the procedural/publicity route; later acts control the disposition.

records.title: CAM appellate filing
records.effect: Records CAM's appellate position; it is not itself an appellate holding.

records.title: AC appellate filing
records.effect: Records the AC's appellate position; it is not itself an appellate holding.

records.title: Aweswell request for updated debt certificate
records.effect: Requested an updated certificate; request does not prove issuance, amount or acceptance.

records.title: AC opposition to CAM reconsideration
records.effect: Records the AC's opposition; the later LAJ/court acts control the result.

records.title: LAJ Diligencia declaring improvement period closed
records.effect: Directed formalization of the premises/pools sale; the 24-Oct-2019 order later set this Diligencia aside.

records.title: LPB reconsideration concerning the liquidation sale
records.effect: Challenged the post-publicity route; the 24-Oct-2019 non-convalidation order is the later primary control.

records.title: AC filing on premises sale and ob-rem linkage
records.effect: Records the AC's position on sale/ob-rem issues; title and debt consequences require judicial/Registry proof.

records.title: Gil Marer filing requesting AC insurance information
records.effect: Requested policy/coverage information; does not establish responsibility or coverage.

records.title: Joint AC/CAM request concerning Aweswell standing
records.effect: Records the request to exclude or limit Aweswell; later standing acts must control the outcome.

records.title: AC filing stating no delivery of possession to CAM
records.effect: Material contemporaneous source statement that possession had not been delivered; does not alone prove every access or control fact.

records.title: Audiencia Provincial order partly allowing LPB appeal
records.effect: Maintained the dation/direct-sale structure but capped ordinary/default interest components used for a third-party improvement threshold; did not finally determine all interest/classification.

records.title: Order refusing validation of the 28-Nov-2018 deed
records.effect: Set aside the 12-Dec-2018 Diligencia, refused to validate the already-consummated deed for lack of prior authorization/plan compliance and restarted better-offer controls.

records.title: LPB reconsideration concerning interest and the 24-Oct order
records.effect: Advanced LPB's res-judicata/interest and implementation objections; the 12-May-2020 order dismissed the motion.

records.title: AC filing and Community debt certificate
records.effect: Binary located; amount and annex linkage must not be asserted from filename before page-faithful OCR/review.

records.title: Order dismissing LPB reconsideration
records.effect: Confirmed the 24-Oct-2019 order, promised submissions before final amount-setting and treated new demolition/access requests as out of time in that motion, not decided on merits.

records.title: LPB clarification/amount submission
records.effect: Records LPB's position on the amount-setting sequence; outcome requires the later judicial order.

records.title: Second Drive copy/variant of LPB clarification filing
records.effect: Near-duplicate source variant; it must not be counted as a second substantive position without binary reconciliation.

records.title: CAM interest certificate annex
records.effect: Binary located; calculation, signatory and underlying ledger require OCR and source reconciliation.

records.title: AC filing concerning Community quantification
records.effect: Records the AC's position and attached material; editorial filename wording is not a finding that the debt was false.

records.title: CAM debt and interest quantification filing
records.effect: Records CAM's asserted calculation; not a final judicial amount by itself.

records.title: LPB submissions on Community credit
records.effect: Records LPB's opposition before clarification/amount setting; not a finding.

records.title: LPB submissions on CAM interest
records.effect: Records LPB's opposition before clarification/amount setting; not a finding.

records.title: Aweswell filing concerning effect on competing offers
records.effect: Records Aweswell's position on offer conditions; not the court's final framework.

records.title: Order refusing clarification of 12-May-2020 order
records.effect: Refused clarification; did not create a new merits disposition.

records.title: Order setting publicity and better-offer conditions
records.effect: Set the quantified third-party improvement framework, including two mortgage components, EUR 400,000, taxes/costs and Community charges.

records.title: Edict publishing the ten-day better-offer route
records.effect: Published the court's quantified conditions; publication performance and responses remain separate evidence.

records.title: Aweswell reconsideration against 25-Jan order
records.effect: Records Aweswell's objections; the 6-May order dismissed the challenge.

records.title: LPB reconsideration against 25-Jan order
records.effect: Records LPB's objections; the 6-May order dismissed the challenge.

records.title: Gil Marer complaint alleging destruction connected to the licitation
records.effect: Connected allegation outside the Mercantile Court docket; filing does not prove receipt, investigation, offence or responsibility.

records.title: LPB application for nullity of proceedings
records.effect: Records LPB's nullity grounds; the 6-May order rejected the application.

records.title: Order rejecting LPB nullity application
records.effect: Rejected nullity; no further appeal was stated to lie against that order.

records.title: Order dismissing Aweswell/LPB reconsideration
records.effect: Confirmed the 25-Jan publicity/better-offer order and dismissed both challenges.

records.title: Providencia opening licitation and setting bond
records.effect: Called the 18-May appearance and fixed a EUR 735,694.02 bond for the improving bidder; private account data is excluded.

records.title: Order 164/2021 definitively approving CAM proposal
records.effect: Approved dation of listed apartments and EUR 400,000 sale of listed premises/pools after recording the third-party bidder's nonappearance and failure to lodge the bond.

records.title: AC observations on Aweswell/LPB challenges
records.effect: The text is dated 20 July despite the filename alias; records the AC's opposition, not the ruling.

records.title: AC report under Article 424 TRLC
records.effect: Calificación material; must remain separate from the asset-sale/adjudication lane.

records.title: Certification concerning prospective project financing
records.effect: Described an early-stage prospective financing/project position; did not prove completed acquisition or financing.

records.title: Order dismissing challenges to 18-May approval
records.effect: Confirmed Order 164/2021 in full and dismissed LPB/Aweswell reconsideration.

records.title: Separate order dismissing challenges to 12-May Providencia
records.effect: Confirmed the 12-May act; later clarification corrected auction/adjudication terminology.

records.title: Further AC report under Article 424 TRLC
records.effect: Calificación material; not an implementation or accounting record by itself.

records.title: LAJ Diligencia incorporating/transferring AC filing 7425/2021
records.effect: Procedurally incorporated and transferred the AC filing; does not adopt its allegations as findings.

January-2013 Article 75 report and complete annexes remain a finite retrieval target.
AC liquidation/suspension request located; scan OCR/review remains.
LPB opposition located with only partial machine text.
Materially adverse judgment resolving the lease for non-payment and ordering vacation of 159 apartments, 29 premises and four pools, with EUR 2,733,923.64 plus interest, later rent and costs.

remaining_denominator_gap: A certified chronological court/LAJ index covering every section/pieza, filing, annex, resolution, receipt, service, appeal, finality event, recording and implementation act from opening to closure.
